Mina (docs): quick check on PR #9102: the /v1/generate example mixes `max_tokens` and `max_new_tokens` in samples, and streaming example shows SSE frames but the SDK snippet uses callback style. Can we align?
Theo (eng-runtime): yeah we introduced `max_new_tokens` as the canonical param last quarter. `max_tokens` is legacy mapping and still accepted server-side for now. We should mark `max_tokens` as deprecated in the example and use `max_new_tokens` everywhere.
Ravi (sdk): our Node snippet generator historically emitted examples with `max_tokens`. I'll update the generator, but need a short docs note explaining migration so users know how to map old behaviour.
Priya (qa): found two customer bug reports where streaming clients dropped trailing tokens because they followed the SSE example but the sample omitted the final ``data: [DONE]`` sentinel. We should include a complete SSE lifecycle in docs.
Mina (docs): propose changes: 1) update sync and async examples to use `max_new_tokens`, 2) add a deprecation callout for `max_tokens` with mapping note (max_tokens -> max_new_tokens if you treat prompt length separately), 3) replace minimal SSE snippet with a full example including `data: [DONE]` and `event: error` handling, 4) update Node and Python SDK snippets to show both streaming and polling approaches.
Theo (eng-runtime): also add a short note about truncation semantics: server enforces token budget post-tokenization and may cut off earlier than naive arithmetic; link to tokenizer behaviour doc.
Ravi (sdk): I'll push a patch for the snippet generator and add an inline comment so future regenerations prefer `max_new_tokens`. For the Node streaming sample, recommend `fetch` + ReadableStream example, and include a short fallback using `await client.generateStream()` for our SDK.
Priya (qa): I'll add a simple CI schema check to the docs repo: ensure examples with "streaming": true include a DONE frame and an example error frame. I can add a test that scans markdown codeblocks for `data: [DONE]`.
merge-bot: PR #9102 updated by Mina (docs): replaced max_tokens with max_new_tokens in examples, added SSE lifecycle example, added deprecation note.
Mina (docs): thanks! two small asks: 1) Theo, can you provide the tokenizer doc link (internal) so I can add it? 2) Ravi, when you update the generator can you add a unit test asserting snippet param names?
Theo (eng-runtime): link posted in PR comment: internal/references/tokenizer-behaviour. Also we plan to normalize header names in next minor but no doc change needed now.
Ravi (sdk): will add generator test and ping when ready.
Priya (qa): ran the new doc CI test locally, it catches the missing DONE frame. Adding to CI now.
Mina (docs): great. Once CI passes I'll merge and follow up with a short migration note in the changelog.
Ravi (sdk): ping me on the PR after merge and I'll cut a micro release so examples in the SDK README match docs.
Mina (docs): will do. Closing thread after merge-bot green.
merge-bot: PR #9102 CI: all checks passed and merged by Mina (docs).
